summary: Production foundation approved and committed locally (cdb62df). Next.js 16 app with Arabic RTL and English LTR routing, PostgreSQL and Prisma 7 with server-side workspace isolation, unified localized errors, structured logging with secret redaction, storage abstraction, Docker and CI.
risks: Docker image build has not run against a real Docker daemon yet; the first real build happens in CI.
Gitleaks secret scanning runs only in CI because GitHub downloads are blocked in the dev container.
The optional local S3 service (SeaweedFS) uses the latest image tag and should be pinned by digest.
GitHub Actions are pinned to major versions rather than commit SHAs.
recommended_next_action: Await explicit human approval before starting Phase 2 (authentication and multi-tenancy runtime).
